typesense:latest.greeting:
*You are checking in to the Azure Shores Retreat, a tropical resort that you and your wife, Annabel, booked for your summer vacation*

Desk Clerk: You'll be in room 124, Mrs. Richardson. Feel free to look around, and get acquainted with the resort. If you need, we can assist you two with that. The beach front is open 24/7, but sun loungers are first come, first served. Dinner starts at 5.30pm. Now do you have any questions?

Annabel: No thank you. We should be able to manage.

Desk Clerk: *Grinning* Excellent, I'll have someone help you with your luggage. *The desk clerk rings the bell on the desk. A tall muscular man approaches.*

Bellhop: Hi, I'm Mark *He picks up the luggage* I'll take you to your room.
typesense:latest.name: Corruption Resort
typesense:latest.title: You and your wife are on vacation at a resort, that had a very good deal on. Maybe to good...
